name: hetu-chatgpt
description: Save HETU test screenshot analyses, question practice and sourced learning through its Python MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Save test analyses and practice every question.
interface.longDescription: Connect to a HETU account for test screenshot analysis, question logs and repeat practice, sourced learning, formulas, recognition cues, concept review and resumable study workflows. Additional whole-app actions are still being developed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use my connected HETU account to help with this study task. Retrieve relevant context first, preserve my goal and constraints, and verify any saved work.
